result.summary: Found 2 visible issues: an invalid discount label and awkwardly clipped horizontal content at the right edge.

issues.description: The second restaurant card displays a “−0%” discount badge, which is nonsensical and suggests a pricing or promotion calculation error.
issues.suggestion: Hide the badge when the discount is zero, or display the correct non-zero discount value.

issues.description: The category row ends with a partially visible blank pill, while the third item in “Fastest near you” has its card and restaurant text cut off at the right edge. Although these may be horizontal carousels, the clipping looks unfinished and gives weak indication that the rows are scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Adjust carousel item widths and right padding so the next item is intentionally previewed with some visible content, or add a clearer horizontal-scroll cue.
